[SWS_CM_99038] Method response message segmentation
Upstream requirements:
RS_SOMEIP_00051
⌈
If the attribute
SomeipMethodDeployment
.
maximumSegmentLengthResponse
is
set to a value, and the data length is larger than
maximumSegmentLengthResponse
,
the SOME/IP response message
shall be transmitted/received using segmenta-
tion as described in [PRS_SOMEIP_00720] and following.
⌋
